title: SQL Advanced
description: 10 advanced SQL Server interview problems covering stored procedures, triggers, indexing, performance tuning, transactions, and isolation levels.
longDescription: This module covers advanced SQL Server topics for senior database developer and DBA roles. Problems include stored procedures, triggers, indexes, query optimization, transactions, isolation levels, error handling, and dynamic SQL.
whatYouLearn: Design and optimize stored procedures with parameters
Implement triggers for data integrity and auditing
Create and tune indexes for query performance
Manage transactions and isolation levels for concurrency
